name: Schema.org structured data
description: Adds Schema.org JSON-LD to every public page: BlogPosting or Article for posts, WebPage for pages, breadcrumbs, the WebSite with its search box on the home page, and the Organization or Person that publishes the site.
author: sap13ns

settings.label: Type of posts
settings.help: BlogPosting suits most blogs; NewsArticle is for news sites.

settings.label: Published by
settings.help: Whether the site belongs to an organization or to one person.

settings.label: Publisher web address
settings.help: https://… Empty uses the site address.

settings.label: Logo or photo
settings.help: https:// address of a square logo (Organization) or a photo (Person), at least 112×112 pixels.

settings.label: Profiles
settings.help: Official profiles of the publisher (Mastodon, GitHub, LinkedIn…), one https:// address per line. At most 10 are used.

settings.label: Breadcrumbs
settings.help: Describe the path Home → category → post, which search engines can show instead of the address.

settings.label: Search box
settings.help: Tell search engines how to search the site (WebSite SearchAction on the home page).

settings.label: Name of the home page in breadcrumbs
settings.help: Empty uses "Home", or "Inicio" on Spanish pages.

settings.label: Name of the home page in breadcrumbs (Spanish)
Name of the home page in breadcrumbs (English)
